Final head for L1: `6403349b2ea85575033ce11e9c24826d976731fc` · 2026-11-19T12:56Z
- CI on this head when read: 40 success, 15 skipped, 0 failed; `Check Changeset` still running. `check-governed-merges --pr 35504`: not governed, 199 lines (+182 / −17, 7 files). `Clause-②: no` · `Metadata-protocol: none`. `Fixes #35412`; item 2 (opens with no source app) is split to #35505 and unchanged here.
- K was 18, so main was merged in by the update-branch relay: landing head `3a14e69119c916905ce4ffe450ec3c3dae990fc8` is that main merge only; its CI is read at landing.
- Item 1 (os-dev report 7009722813): the console inbox's `openRequest` opens a queue row at `/apps/CURRENT/sys_approval_request/record/ID` whenever the inbox route has an app segment, from the component inbox and `system/approvals` alike. `RequestDeepLink` / `requestPagePath` unchanged, so Home, notification and email opens still go to the owner app, else Setup. An inbox with no app segment is unchanged; the record card keeps its owner-app link.
- Item 3 (round 1): the record crumb draws the object label until the route's record is held, then its title; the title is keyed by `object:id` with `pageRecordFor`, so a step never names the new record with the old title. "Open next" keeps the app (pinned for a business app's component inbox).
- Prior ruling (checked per the seat): the "owner app, else Setup" routing came from PR #32850 / #32667 — the filer's Expected line, the dev's own fallback design and a seat ACCEPT (6837076176); no maintainer ruling set it (the only maintainer words in that chain, 「可以」 in 6837571290, let a p2 card land). #35412's approval is later and names item 1. Recorded in the PR's Acceptance notes.
- Tests: 36 files / 317 tests over every inbox reader plus the census tests; console type-check clean. Ablation: `openRequest`'s in-app branch forced off → exactly the 3 in-app pins red; restored blob == HEAD. Item 3: 103 files / 842 tests, 2 ablations red. `dispatch-gates --commands`: 39 run, 0 not measured.
- Side effect, noted in the PR: Home's 「审批中心」 opens the inbox under Home's host app, so a row opened from that list now stays in the host app.

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在某个应用自己的"待我审批"里打开一条审批，现在留在这个应用里（应用名、侧边栏、路径都不变），审批完点"下一条"也还在这个应用里；记录页顶部的路径在加载时显示对象名（如"审批请求"），不再闪现一串编号。
- 为什么做：以前每审批一条就被带到别的应用或设置里，业务人员要来回切换。
- 出错会怎样：从首页、通知或邮件打开的审批不受影响，仍按原规则打开；审批页里的记录卡片仍跳到该记录所属的应用。
- 要你做什么：无。区域自行落地。

## 席位核对

**L1-a: ACCEPT** · reviewed head `6403349b2ea85575033ce11e9c24826d976731fc`, landing head `3a14e69119c916905ce4ffe450ec3c3dae990fc8` · Fixes #35412 · 2026-11-19T12:58Z

**Merge delta.** `3a14e69119` merges main `895dd437f4` into `6403349b2e`. The PR's own diff is byte-identical before and after it, checked by `diff` of `git diff merge-base..6403349b2e` against `git diff M^2..M`, so it is main-only. Readings now: K=0; `check-governed-merges --pr 35504` not governed; `merge-tree` against main clean. CI on `6403349b2e` is 41 success / 15 skipped / 0 failed, with Check Changeset finished since the relay read it. CI on `3a14e69119` was still running at review time (7 success, 16 in progress, 0 failed), so land on its green.

**Code (7 files, +182/−17).**
- **Routing** (`ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx` `openRequest`). An inbox with an app segment opens `/apps/${appName}/sys_approval_request/record/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`. Only an inbox with no app falls back to `requestPagePath`, the deep-link rule of owner app, else Setup. The relay's prior-ruling check holds: no maintainer ruling set the old routing.
- **Title per record** (`RecordDetailView.tsx`). `recordTitle` becomes `heldRecordTitle {record, title}`, read back only when `record === ${objectName}:${recordId}`. `pageRecordFor` is set beside `setPageRecord(rec)` with the read's own `decidedKey`, which is the same `object:id` form, since `pureRecordId` is `recordId`. The title effect waits until `pageRecordFor === routeRecordKey`. So on an in-place step (↓ ↑, `j`/`k`, open next), the crumb, the favourite, the Recently Accessed entry and the pane title never carry the previous record's title.
- **Crumb.** The resolved title is used if there is one. Otherwise it is the landed record's display name, resolved in the same render. A held record with no name shows its short id. A record still in flight shows the object's served label.

**Pins.**
- `ApprovalsInboxPage.opensServedPage-12484` (updated) and `queueStepper-34586`: the row stays in the inbox's app, and the no-app inbox keeps `requestPagePath`.
- `approvalQueueAdvance-34586`: open next, and the last decision returns, within the app.
- `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524`: the crumb shows the object label while loading, never the raw id, and never the previous title across a step. The short-id CONTROL holds for a loaded record with no name.

All of these sit in the existing harness files.

**Declaration: agreed.** `Clause-②: no` / `Metadata-protocol: none` / `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/console` patch. No locale key, prop or export changes.

**Routing.** Not governed, no contract face: ux-1 lands `3a14e69119` on green CI. A new push needs a fresh L1 only if it changes more than a main merge.

## 席位核对

**Correction to L1-a record 7009816770 (#35504), Pins paragraph only** · 2026-11-19T12:59Z

I wrote that paragraph before reading the new test cases, and two of its claims are wrong. Read against the diff, the added cases are:
- `opensServedPage-12484`: a queue row opens in the inbox's app though another app owns the record; a row whose object no app lists stays in the inbox's app, never in Setup.
- `queueStepper-34586` and `approvalQueueAdvance-34586`: each decision opens the next request under the same app, and the last returns to that app's inbox.
- `topBar-27524`: the crumb names the object until the read lands, never the id; a step to the next record names it by its object, not by the record left.

**Not pinned by new cases**, though my record said they were:
1. The short-id fallback for a loaded record with no name.
2. The no-app inbox keeping `requestPagePath`. Only the describe title names the deep-link rule, which the pre-existing #32667 cases cover.

Neither changes the verdict. The no-app branch is the unchanged call. The short-id branch is the old expression moved behind `holdsRouteRecord`. **ACCEPT stands**, and ux-1 lands on green CI.
